captions.instagram:
Concept. Not a client project. Wrenfield is a fictional café.

Open on Boxing Day? On this homepage you swipe through photos, read “Open 7 days” (true, except when it isn’t), and the Christmas hours are in an Instagram post that never finishes loading.

So we put today’s hours under the name and the holiday hours on the homepage as plain text, every changed day from 24 December to 1 January. Then one button to call.

Are your holiday hours somewhere people will find them? Free review at prycedigital.com/book
